stops.name: Wiesmahdweg
stops.quote: Ranger Deniz Göcen is now also completely in her element on the “Wiesmahdweg” during the guided tour through “her” Ammergau Alps Nature Park.
stops.english: Ranger Deniz Göcen is now also completely in her element on the “Wiesmahdweg” during the guided tour through “her” Ammergau Alps Nature Park.

stops.name: Oberammergau
stops.quote: The southern slopes above the picture-postcard silhouettes of Oberammergau and Unterammergau are as rich in species as they are in panoramic views.
stops.english: The southern slopes above the picture-postcard silhouettes of Oberammergau and Unterammergau are as rich in species as they are in panoramic views.

stops.name: Unterammergau
stops.quote: Near Unterammergau there are whole meadows full of irises
stops.english: Near Unterammergau there are whole meadows full of irises

stops.name: Kreuzspitze
stops.quote: In order to gain a proper overview, you can climb to the top of the region and reach the summit of the 2,185-metre Kreuzspitze.
stops.english: In order to gain a proper overview, you can climb to the top of the region and reach the summit of the 2,185-metre Kreuzspitze.

stops.name: Ammertal valley
stops.quote: The Ammertal valley has preserved one of the largest mountain, meadow and pasture landscapes in Bavaria.
stops.english: The Ammertal valley has preserved one of the largest mountain, meadow and pasture landscapes in Bavaria.

stops.name: Schleifmühlklamm gorge
stops.quote: One literally refreshing side trip on this hot summer day is a visit to the Schleifmühlklamm gorge near Unterammergau, at the entrance of which the whetstone makers used to be active.
stops.english: One literally refreshing side trip on this hot summer day is a visit to the Schleifmühlklamm gorge near Unterammergau, at the entrance of which the whetstone makers used to be active.

stops.name: Soier See
stops.quote: A rather quiet body of water, on the other hand, can be found with Soier See, a landscape conservation area situated almost dead centre in Bad Bayersoien, whose shores were home to settlers stretching all the way back to the Celts.
stops.english: A rather quiet body of water, on the other hand, can be found with Soier See, a landscape conservation area situated almost dead centre in Bad Bayersoien, whose shores were home to settlers stretching all the way back to the Celts.

stops.name: Bad Bayersoien
stops.quote: Today, you can enjoy peace and quiet around the lake in Bad Bayersoien and take in dragonflies, sundew, orchids and gentians.
stops.english: Today, you can enjoy peace and quiet around the lake in Bad Bayersoien and take in dragonflies, sundew, orchids and gentians.

stops.name: war memorial chapel
stops.quote: The war memorial chapel in Bad Bayersoien
stops.english: The war memorial chapel in Bad Bayersoien

stops.name: Wetzstein Ridge
stops.quote: At the end of the tour, we head up to the heights once more: in the evening, we make our way to the Wetzstein Ridge near Saulgrub.
stops.english: At the end of the tour, we head up to the heights once more: in the evening, we make our way to the Wetzstein Ridge near Saulgrub.
